items.title: CZ Predicts Bitcoin Will Overtake Gold This Bull Run
points: CZ (Binance founder Changpeng Zhao) predicts Bitcoin will surpass gold's total market value during the current bull market cycle, signaling confidence in continued crypto adoption.

items.title: Bitcoin Faces Critical $81,000–$86,000 Resistance Zone
points: Bitcoin faces a critical $81,000–$86,000 supply zone where long-term holders, options hedges, and short liquidation clusters converge.

The zone contains four overlapping barriers: long-term holders near breakeven, self-custody accumulation starting ~$80,800, options dealer hedges near $82,300, and short liquidation clusters between $82,000–$86,000.
8 consecutive days of ETF inflows totaling $2.8 billion support the rally; a close above $83,300 with continued inflows signals overhead supply is being absorbed.
August 19 saw the largest short liquidation event since 2019, compressing futures open interest by 11%.
Breaking above the zone could reach January highs, while falling below exposes a drop to $62,900, erasing the entire recovery.

items.title: Revolut Launches Euro Stablecoin EURR on Ethereum
points: Revolut launched EURR, a euro-denominated stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged 1:1 to a fiat currency) on Ethereum, targeting its 80 million users in the European Economic Area.
The move follows the PayPal PYUSD model of a regulated fintech issuing its own stablecoin to capture onchain payment flows.

It arrives as MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, the EU's crypto regulatory framework) creates clearer issuance pathways, entering a Euro stablecoin segment that has lagged USD-pegged counterparts.
Integration into Revolut's core app for transfers and spending could reshape Euro stablecoin market share on Ethereum.

items.title: $8.7M Exploit Hits Moonwell on Base
points: An $8.7M exploit on Moonwell's Base (an Ethereum layer-2 network) deployment involved attackers manipulating collateral using illiquid MAMO tokens.
Attackers borrowed real cbBTC (Coinbase-wrapped Bitcoin) against the artificially inflated collateral prices, triggering emergency borrowing caps.

items.title: How Neobanks Make Money Beyond Interchange Fees
points: Neobanks (digital-only banks without physical branches) monetize through 14+ revenue streams beyond interchange fees, including FX markups, lending spreads, float on deposits, subscriptions, and embedded software.
Streams include on/off-ramp spreads, yield products, credit cards, wire fees, payroll, travel commissions, and brokerage/investing services.
The core thesis: owning more of a customer's financial life creates more monetizable surfaces and higher switching costs, making platforms harder to replace.

items.title: LayerZero Launching Institutional Blockchain Exchange
points: LayerZero is launching an institutional blockchain-based exchange this fall backed by Citadel Securities, DTCC (US securities clearing), and Intercontinental Exchange.
It positions LayerZero's cross-chain messaging technology as settlement infrastructure for institutional capital markets.

The move signals institutional finance shifting from opposing stablecoins toward deploying tokenized infrastructure; a dozen-plus banks recently announced a joint stablecoin venture after a year of resistance.

sections.title: 2. Revolut's Euro Stablecoin Entry into DeFi

sections.title: 3. Neobank Revenue Diversification Beyond Interchange
